app.name: Browserdeck
editor.label: Label
pairing.title: Pair phone
pairing.scan: Scan this code with your phone camera.
pairing.firewall: Windows may ask to allow this app through the firewall. Choose Allow, or your phone cannot connect.
pairing.publicWifi: Use this on your home network only. On public WiFi, others could read the pairing code.
pairing.noNetwork: This PC is not on a local network. Connect to WiFi, then come back.
pairing.ipChanged: If the phone stops connecting, scan this code again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.adminWarning: Administrator mode lets shortcut buttons reach apps running as administrator. Apps opened by buttons still run normally, unless the button has “Run as administrator” turned on.
settings.gamesLimit: Some games and anti-cheat software ignore simulated keys. This cannot be fixed here.
tray.stillRunning: The app is still running in the system tray.
phone.kicked: Another phone took over this deck.
phone.badToken: This pairing code is no longer valid. Scan the code on your PC again.
phone.empty: No buttons yet. Add some in the desktop app.
error.bind_failed: The phone server could not start: no free port was found.
error.admin_token_failed: Administrator mode could not set up its pairing code, so the phone server is off. Open the app again; if it keeps happening, turn administrator mode off.
error.file_not_found: The file could not be found.
error.launch_failed: The app could not be started.
error.blocked_by_elevated_window: The active window runs as administrator, so the shortcut was blocked. Turn on administrator mode in Settings.
error.volume_failed: The volume could not be changed.
error.obs_scene_missing: OBS has no scene with this name.
error.media_failed: The media key could not be sent. On macOS, allow Browserdeck under Privacy & Security, Accessibility.
error.unsupported_platform: This action is not supported on this system.
error.timeout: The action took too long and was stopped.
error.no_pages: There must be at least one page.
error.bad_grid: The grid size is not valid.
error.slot_out_of_range: A button sits outside the grid. Move or delete it first.
error.duplicate_slot: Two buttons share the same slot.
error.duplicate_id: Two items share the same ID.
error.bad_icon_file: The icon file is missing or not valid.
error.bad_theme: The chosen theme does not exist.
error.bad_port: The port number is not valid.
error.save_failed: The settings could not be saved.
error.bad_json: The file is not valid JSON.
error.bad_schema: The file is not a theme of a supported version.
error.bad_id: The theme ID may only use lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
error.bad_name: The theme name is empty or too long.
error.out_of_range: A theme value is out of its allowed range.
error.builtin_id: This ID belongs to a built-in theme.
error.io: The file could not be read or written.
error.bad_type: This file type is not supported.
editor.dragHint: Drag an action onto a slot. With the keyboard: Space lifts, arrow keys choose a slot, Enter drops, Escape cancels. Enter on an empty slot opens a menu.
editor.dragHelp: Press Space to lift. Use the arrow keys to choose a slot, Enter to drop, Escape to cancel.
editor.noSelection: Select a button to edit it, or drag an action onto an empty slot.
editor.glyphMore: Showing {shown} of {total}. Type more to narrow it down.
editor.glyphLoadFailed: The icon list could not be loaded.
editor.mediaHint: Works on whatever is playing: Spotify, a browser tab, the system player.
editor.usageHint: The phone shows it live, every 2 seconds. Temperature needs a sensor Windows can read; many PCs only report it in administrator mode, or not at all.
editor.argsHint: Separate arguments with spaces. Wrap one in "double quotes" if it contains spaces.
editor.runAsAdminHint: Windows asks for permission on this PC each time the button is pressed.
editor.hotkeyPress: Press the keys, then let go…
editor.obsOffline: OBS is not connected. Type the scene name exactly as it appears in OBS.
editor.recovered: The settings file was damaged and has been reset. The old file was kept as {file}.
editor.hotkeyUnsupported: That key is not supported. Try another.
editor.hotkeyNeedsKey: Add a key besides Ctrl, Shift, Alt or Win/Cmd.
pairing.intro: Open the camera on your phone and point it at this code. Your phone and this PC must be on the same WiFi.
pairing.addressHint: Pick the one your phone is on. The name ending in .local keeps working when the PC gets a new IP (iPhone, Android 12 or newer).
pairing.link: Or type this address into your phone's browser
pairing.secret: This address contains the pairing code. Keep it private.
pairing.regenerateConfirm: A new code disconnects the phone that is paired now, and the old code stops working. Make a new code?
pairing.connectedHint: Your phone is paired. Now build your buttons.
pairing.serverError: The phone server could not start, so there is no code to scan.
settings.gridNoFit: Some buttons would fall outside a smaller grid. Move or delete them first.
settings.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
settings.obsHelpDisconnected: Start OBS and turn on its WebSocket server (Tools, WebSocket Server Settings).
settings.obsHelpAuth: OBS rejected the password. Check it in OBS under Tools, WebSocket Server Settings.
settings.obsHelpUnsupported: OBS is too old; version 30.2 or newer is needed
settings.portNote: Takes effect after you restart the app.
editor.pressFailed: A button press from the phone failed: {reason}
editor.runtimeFailed: Some app details could not be read, so image icons and a few hints may be missing. Restart the app if this keeps happening.
pairing.loadError: Could not read this PC's network address.
settings.adminRisk: Only turn this on if you need it: harmful software already on this PC could use it to gain administrator rights. Turning it on or off changes the pairing code: scan the QR code again on your phone.
settings.adminOffAfterRestart: Administrator mode turns off once you restart the app.
error.autostart_failed: Start with Windows could not be changed.
settings.adminInactive: Administrator mode is on, but the app is not running as administrator right now.
error.needs_machine_install: Administrator mode needs Browserdeck installed in Program Files. Reinstall it and keep the default install folder.
editor.renameHint: Double-click or press F2 to rename
settings.defaultsNote: A page can choose its own with Page settings, above its grid.
